properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live ECB-mode single-block encrypt/decrypt API of the riscv-crypto benchmark library: 6 declarations in api_aes.h, full implementations in reference/aes_enc.c, aes_dec.c and ttable/aes_enc.c, aes_dec.c, and 6 call sites in the test harnesses (test_block_aes_128/192/256.c). ECB (no chaining, no IV) is genuinely what these functions do — the benchmark uses raw single-block ECB to cycle-count the cipher core, but the API ships ECB semantics unchanged to any consumer. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SM4 (Chinese national standard GB/T 32907-2016) block cipher as shipped in the riscv-crypto benchmark library: API declarations (api_sm4.h), a portable reference implementation (sm4_reference.c), a RISC-V vector-crypto intrinsics implementation (zscrypto/sm4_zscrypto.c) and test-harness calls (test_block_sm4.c). Not NIST-approved but a real, complete cipher implementation in the tree — changeable here if the project wants to restrict itself to NIST ciphers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128 key schedule + ECB encrypt/decrypt in the riscv-crypto benchmark library: API declarations (api_aes.h), reference and ttable implementations, exercised by test_block_aes_128.c (including with the published FIPS-197/SP800-38A test key 2b7e1516... and hardware rdrandom keys). Below CNSA 2.0's AES-256 floor under Grover but a sound cipher; the module also ships AES-192 and AES-256 variants. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-3 (Keccak-f[1600] sponge) module of the riscv-crypto benchmark library: FIPS202_SHA3_224/256/384/512 wrappers (fips202.c/h) over the Keccak permutation, with reference and RV64 zscrypto implementations (KeccakP1600 round constants, StatePermute), exercised by test_hash_sha3.c. Strong post-quantum-relevant hashing; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHAKE128/SHAKE256 extendable-output functions (NIST FIPS 202) implemented in the riscv-crypto benchmark library (fips202.c/fips202.h, built on the Keccak permutation). Post-quantum-relevant, strong primitives; kept as inventory of the shipped XOF surface. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 key schedule + ECB encrypt/decrypt in the riscv-crypto benchmark library: API declarations, reference and ttable implementations, exercised by test_block_aes_256.c with the published SP800-38A test key and hardware rdrandom keys. Meets CNSA 2.0 symmetric floor (Grover leaves 128-bit margin); strongest symmetric variant shipped. Changeable here.
